title: L-Town water distribution network (BattLeDIM 2020 benchmark)
source: Vrachimis et al., BattLeDIM 2020 dataset, Zenodo 4017659 (CC BY 4.0): utility EPANET model with nominal parameters and 2018 SCADA (5-min pressures, flows, tank level). The SCADA was generated from a 'real' model with demand deviations, noise and leakages unknown to the utility.
task_type: model calibration against SCADA time series
question: The utility's EPANET model of L-Town uses nominal demands and pipe roughness. Calibrate it against the first week of 2018 SCADA (5-minute data: 33 pressures, 2 inlet flows, pump flow, tank T1 level). Report the calibration quality per sensor against common calibration guidance (e.g. pressures within +/-0.5 m for most readings, flows within +/-5%), which parameter groups you adjusted and why, and where residuals remain after calibration that point to model errors or unaccounted water loss (leakage) - name the sensors and areas. Give the water balance for the week (metered inflow vs. modelled demand).

eps.notes: Observation flows converted from m3/h to l/s; times in hours from 2018-01-01 00:00 (a Monday). The model's weekly patterns start Monday 00:00.

exclude_reason: Calibration quality is measured directly by the fit statistics; no engineers' report to score against.
